The '''boost meter''' was a component in a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer's]] systems meant to control temporary increases in the speed of the vehicle. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] had a boost meter.
